source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps equal repeated appeals to both named women.
key_decisions.before: I urge Euodia, and I urge Syntyche, to have the same mind in the Lord.
key_decisions.after: I appeal to Euodia, and I appeal to Syntyche: be of one mind in the Lord.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the women's active labor, named colleague and the book image without inventing the companion's identity.
key_decisions.before: Yes, and I ask you also, my true companion, help these women. They struggled alongside me in the gospel, together with Clement and the rest of my coworkers, whose names are in the book of life.
key_decisions.after: Yes, I ask you too, my true companion, help these women. They struggled beside me for the good news, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Yes, and I ask you also, my true companion, help these women, for they struggled beside me in the work of the gospel, together with Clement and the rest of my coworkers, whose names are in the book of life.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps universal visibility and the open spatial/temporal nearness.
key_decisions.before: Let your gentleness be known to everyone. The Lord is near.
key_decisions.after: Let everyone know your gentleness. The Lord is near.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let your gentleness be known to everyone. The Lord is near.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves anything/everything and all three modes of address without adding diagnosis or advice.
key_decisions.before: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything, by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
key_decisions.after: Do not be anxious about anything. Instead, in everything, with prayer, petition and thanksgiving, make your requests known to God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do not worry about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps incomprehensible peace and the guarding image over both hearts and minds.
key_decisions.before: And the peace of God, which surpasses every understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.after: And God's peace, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains all six qualities and both conditional values in readable sequence.
key_decisions.before: Finally, brothers and sisters, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is just, whatever is pure, whatever is pleasing, whatever is commendable—if there is any excellence and if there is anything worthy of praise—think about these things.
key_decisions.after: Finally, brothers and sisters, whatever is true, honorable, just, pure, lovely or commendable—if anything is excellent, if anything deserves praise—give these things your attention.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Finally, brothers and sisters, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is just, whatever is pure, whatever is pleasing, whatever is commendable—if there is any excellence and if there is anything worthy of praise—think about these things.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the flourishing image and explicitly avoids blaming them for the interruption.
key_decisions.before: I rejoiced greatly in the Lord that now at last your concern for me has flourished again. You were indeed concerned for me, but you had no opportunity.
key_decisions.after: I rejoiced greatly in the Lord that your concern for me has blossomed again. You were concerned before, but had no opportunity to act.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I rejoiced in the Lord greatly that now at last you have revived your concern for me; indeed, you were concerned for me, but you had no opportunity.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains learned contentment and the speaker's qualification of his thanks.
key_decisions.before: I do not say this because I am in need, for I have learned to be content in whatever circumstances I am.
key_decisions.after: I am not saying this because I am in need, for I have learned to be content in whatever circumstances I face.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Not that I am speaking of being in need, for I have learned to be content with whatever I have.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the paired bodily and economic conditions rather than a generalized success claim.
key_decisions.before: I know how to be brought low, and I know how to abound. In any and every circumstance I have learned the secret—being well fed and being hungry, having abundance and being in need.
key_decisions.after: I know how to live with little, and I know how to have plenty. In every situation I have learned the secret: being well fed or hungry, having plenty or going without.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I know what it is to be brought low, and I know what it is to abound. In any and every circumstance, I have learned the secret of facing plenty and hunger, abundance and need.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the broad all things expression and the unnamed strengthening agent; immediate circumstances remain in a note.
key_decisions.before: I can do all things through the one who strengthens me.
key_decisions.after: I have strength for all things through the one who strengthens me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I can do all things through the one who strengthens me.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains place, time, unique partnership and the accounting metaphor.
key_decisions.before: And you Philippians know that in the beginning of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving except you alone.
key_decisions.after: You Philippians know that in the early days of the good news, when I left Macedonia, no church shared with me in the account of giving and receiving except you alone.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And you Philippians yourselves know that in the beginning of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving except you alone.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the named location and the idiomatic repeated provision.
key_decisions.before: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent help for my needs more than once.
key_decisions.after: Even in Thessalonica, you sent help for my needs more than once.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For even in Thessalonica you sent me help for my needs more than once.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves fruit and account imagery together rather than reducing it to money.
key_decisions.before: Not that I seek the gift itself; I seek the fruit that increases to your account.
key_decisions.after: It is not the gift I seek, but the fruit that grows to your account.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Not that I seek the gift, but I seek the fruit that increases to your account.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains receipt language, the messenger and all sacrificial descriptions.
key_decisions.before: I have received everything in full and have more than enough. I am well supplied, having received from Epaphroditus the gifts you sent—a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, pleasing to God.
key_decisions.after: I have received everything in full and have more than enough. I am well supplied now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus—a fragrant aroma, an acceptable sacrifice, pleasing to God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I have received full payment and more; I am well supplied, having received from Epaphroditus the gifts you sent, a fragrant offering, a sacrifice acceptable and pleasing to God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps every need, God's measure of supply and the relation to Christ.
key_decisions.before: And my God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.after: And my God will meet every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And my God will fully supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the whole group and the specified imperial household without identifying occupations.
key_decisions.before: All the saints greet you, especially those of Caesar's household.
key_decisions.after: All the saints send you greetings, especially those of Caesar's household.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: All the saints greet you, especially those of the emperor’s household.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the singular spirit addressed to the plural community and the short ending.
key_decisions.before: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
key_decisions.after: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
